us-oh-in-pa-p3-tierpoint-valley-forge-pa.summary: TierPoint's Valley Forge page says that, 25 miles north-west of the Philadelphia metro area near I-76, 'the state-of-the-art TierPoint Valley Forge data center and colocation facility enables companies in many industries to increase business agility and improve IT performance', that the secure data center hosts a TierPoint multitenant cloud pod, and that TierPoint also operates other Pennsylvania data centers. It lists 137,000+ total square feet, 61,000+ square feet of raised floor, 24,000+ square feet of business-continuity seating, nine 2.5 MW redundant generators with at least 48 hours of runtime, DWDM connectivity to 401 N Broad St and its compliance audits, and gives the address 1000 Adams Avenue, Norristown, PA 19403. These present-tense statements describe an operating data center. Generator ratings are not IT load.
